youtube_short.title: Websites Charge iPhone Users 30% More
title_alternatives: Your Phone Type Determines Your Price Online
Dynamic Pricing: Why Your iPhone Costs You More
youtube_short.description: Amazon changes its prices 2.5 million times a day — and your device type determines what price you see. Studies show Mac and iPhone users get shown prices up to 30% higher on hotels and flights. Orbitz was literally caught hiding cheaper rooms from Apple users in 2012. The fix is simple: open an incognito window, clear your cookies, or use a VPN before big purchases. That one habit saves shoppers $200 to $800 every year. Follow for more money traps they don't want you to find. #finance #money #dynamicpricing #shoppinghacks #personalfinance
